about_the_game:
Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fast-paced racing game for the whole family. Parallel to the worldwide cinema release of GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE, the popular Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda are celebrating their video game debut! Climb into the cockpit with the two heroes of the film GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE and six other colourful characters. Fans of the film and the Europa-Park are looking forward to a reunion!

The races will take you to well-known locations across Europe. Whether it's a Free Race, Point Chase, Time Trial or the Grand Prix - there are plenty of opportunities to put your driving skills to the test! And you'll need skill, because Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is really fast thanks to different boost techniques!

Each character not only has their own vehicle, but also individual strengths and weaknesses. So every race feels different - depending on who you send onto the track.

But Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions isn't just fun to play alone: in local multiplayer for up to four people, you can experience exciting races together and create unforgettable moments - because Ed & Edda is all about sharing the fun!

 

Key features of Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions:

 

  • Fast-paced races: On fast tracks, around famous attractions from all over Europe, provide variety!

  • Fast on the road: Various boost techniques ensure very high speed!

  • Eight playable characters: including Ed & Edda, the famous Europa-Park mascots!

  • Many possibilities: Unique racers, clever power-ups and customisable vehicles ensure variety and fun!

  • Multiplayer: Up to four drivers can race at the same time - perfect for families and friends!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i5, 2.5 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD R9 285, Nvidia GTX 1630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 3770k 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 7950, Nvidia RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions is a fun racing game for the whole family that brings the famous mascots of the Europa-Park to life. Players can – either alone or with their friends – race through several European landmarks to find out who is the fastest!
